name: cRZIStream::QueryInterface
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Accepts id 1 and 0x051b11bd (original subtracts 1, then compares with 0x051b11bc). Mutants killed: no AddRef; second id rejected. Hook by RVA shares its code with the cRZIStream subobjects of other classes.

name: cRZIStream::GetSint8
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slots 4 and 5 (Sint8 and Uint8) share it; both tested via the vtable. Mutant killed: ignores a failed read. Code is shared by 15 classes (cRZIStream subobjects); the hook assumes all have the same layout at +8.

name: cRZIStream::GetSint16
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slots 6 and 7. Swaps unless the flag at +8 is nonzero. Mutants killed: swap condition inverted. Short and refused reads covered.

name: cRZIStream::GetSint32
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slots 8 and 9. Same byte-order rule as GetSint16.

name: cRZIStream::GetFloat32
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 12. Raw 4-byte read, never swapped. Code shared by 15 classes.

name: cRZIStream::GetFloat64
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 13. Raw 8-byte read, never swapped. Mutant killed: reads 4 bytes instead of 8.

name: cRZIStream::GetGZSerializable
notes: Differential: 2,000 cases. Calls the serializable's slot 4 with this stream as its one stack argument and returns its result. Mutant killed: slot 3. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZIStream::Construct
notes: Differential: 4,000 cases, junk in the whole object. Clears count and owner, installs the base vtable, stores the low byte of the argument at +8. Mutants killed: owner not cleared, flag from order != 0. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZIStream::Destruct
notes: Differential: 2,000 cases with and without an owner; owner Release (slot 2) and the vtable at that moment compared. Mutants killed: vtable not reset, wrong slot. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed). Three byte-identical copies exist in db/families.jsonl (other classes); only this RVA is hooked.

name: cRZIStream::DeletingDestructor
notes: Differential: 3,000 cases over flag sets: Destruct directly, sized delete of 0x10 when bit 0 is set, returns this. Mutants killed: delete on any nonzero flag, Destruct skipped. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZIStream::GetSint64
notes: Differential: 20,000 cases (0..11 byte scripts, refusals, all flags). Reads 8 bytes through slot 17, swaps all eight unless the flag byte is nonzero (ByteSwap64), returns bool. Mutants killed: inverted flag, half swap. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZIStream::GetPackedUint32
notes: Differential: 30,000 cases: valid packed values, arbitrary 1..7-byte groups, single bytes, empty and truncated streams. The byte buffer starts as two copies of `this` and failed reads leave it stale; this is mirrored (the test object stays at one address). *out is zeroed first; the second stack argument is unused; returns 0. ORIGINAL-BUG (not reproduced): 8 or more continuation bytes overrun the 8-byte stack buffer; ours has 16 bytes and the tests stay below 8. Mutants killed: *out not cleared, either half of the `this` fill, high bit not masked, shift 8 instead of 7. Not exercised: top byte of `this` >= 0x80. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZIStream::GetRZCharStr
notes: Differential: 30,000 cases (lengths 0..39, sizes 0..23 and exactly the length, short and refused streams, a stream already in error). Calls (read, GetError, Skip) logged in order. ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced: the terminator is written at buf[min(length, size)], one past a buffer of exactly that length (the test buffer has room and its bytes are compared). Mutants killed: wrong clamp, terminator position, skip count, skip despite error. Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).

name: cRZIStream::GetGZStr
notes: Differential: 12,000 cases (lengths up to 600 including 0xfe, 0xff, 0x100, 0x1ff, 0x200; short, refused and pre-failed streams). FromChar of the game's empty literal first, packed length, chunks of at most 0xff appended (slot 20) with GetError after each chunk. Mutants killed: other empty string pointer, chunk size, error check after a chunk, error before reading. One equivalent mutant: the chunk limit written as `remaining < 0xff` (same counts). Not yet run in-game (hook entry added, not deployed).
